description: Separating genuine intragenic UROC1 pathogenic alleles from incidental multigene 3q CNVs in ClinVar
code:
import requests, time, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}; E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
ids=requests.get(E+"esearch.fcgi",params={"db":"clinvar","term":"UROC1[gene]","retmax":500,"retmode":"json"},
                 headers=H,timeout=60).json()["esearchresult"]["idlist"]
recs=[]
for i in range(0,len(ids),200):
    s=requests.get(E+"esummary.fcgi",params={"db":"clinvar","id":",".join(ids[i:i+200]),"retmode":"json"},headers=H,timeout=120).json()
    for k,v in s.get("result",{}).items():
        if k=="uids": continue
        gc=v.get("germline_classification",{}) or {}
        vs=(v.get("variation_set") or [{}])[0]
        recs.append(dict(title=v.get("title",""),cls=gc.get("description","") or "not provided",
                         vtype=vs.get("variant_type","")))
    time.sleep(0.4)
cv=pd.DataFrame(recs)

# Is a "Pathogenic" record an intragenic UROC1 variant or a multigene chromosome 3 CNV?
cnv_types={"copy number gain","copy number loss"}
def kind(r):
    t=r.title
    if r.vtype in cnv_types or ("chr3:" in t and "x" in t) or t=="Single allele" or t.startswith("NC_0000"):
        return "multigene 3q CNV / unspecified allele"
    return "intragenic UROC1 variant"
cv["kind"]=cv.apply(kind,axis=1)
path=cv[cv.cls.isin(["Pathogenic","Likely pathogenic","Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic"])]
print(path.groupby(["kind","vtype"]).size())
print("\nIntragenic P/LP UROC1 variants:")
for t in path[path.kind=="intragenic UROC1 variant"].title: print("  ",t)

order=["Pathogenic","Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic","Likely pathogenic","Conflicting classifications of pathogenicity",
       "Uncertain significance","Likely benign","Benign/Likely benign","Benign","not provided"]
counts=[int((cv.cls==o).sum()) for o in order]
cols=["#9e2a2b","#b5533c","#c98b45","#d9b44a","#9aa0a6","#6fa8a0","#4e8f87","#2f6f6a","#cccccc"]

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,5.2))
lab=[o.replace("Conflicting classifications of pathogenicity","Conflicting").replace("Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic","Path./Likely path.") for o in order]
axes[0].barh(range(len(order))[::-1],counts,color=cols)
axes[0].set_yticks(range(len(order))[::-1]); axes[0].set_yticklabels(lab,fontsize=9)
for i,c in zip(range(len(order))[::-1],counts): axes[0].text(c+3,i,str(c),va="center",fontsize=9)
axes[0].set_xlabel("ClinVar records"); axes[0].set_xlim(0,165)
axes[0].set_title("UROC1 germline classifications in ClinVar (n = %d)"%len(cv),fontsize=11)

k=path.kind.value_counts()
axes[1].bar(range(len(k)),k.values,color=["#9e2a2b","#9aa0a6"][:len(k)],width=0.55)
axes[1].set_xticks(range(len(k)))
axes[1].set_xticklabels([x.replace(" / ","\n/ ").replace("multigene","multigene\n") for x in k.index],fontsize=9)
for i,v in enumerate(k.values): axes[1].text(i,v+0.2,str(v),ha="center",fontsize=10)
axes[1].set_ylabel("Pathogenic or likely pathogenic records")
axes[1].set_title("Most UROC1 'pathogenic' records are whole-arm 3q\ncopy number events, not urocanase alleles",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
